# Badge

```tsx
import { Badge, BadgeObject, badgeVariants } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A small count or status dot, often on the corner of another element. Mirrors the Figma Badge component: Show Label × Color (Neutral / Accent, named Brand in Figma / Info / Success / Warning / Danger / Inverse / On Color), and Badge Object for the corner placement.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Surface
  dark={darkColors.includes(args.color ?? "")}
  fill={fillCanvas(viewMode)}
>
  <BadgeStory {...args} />
</Surface>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Badge component: Show Label × Color (Neutral / Accent, named Brand in Figma / Info / Success / Warning / Danger / Inverse / On Color). With a label it's a 16px pill with a 12px Medium count; without one it's an 8px dot centered in a 16px box. Badge Object is BadgeObject.

## Variants

`badgeVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `neutral`, `accent`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `inverse`, `on-color` | `accent` |
| `showLabel` | `true`, `false` | `true` |

## Rules

- Import `Badge` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
